_comment: PLACEHOLDER demo vocabulary — intellectual/creative engagement angles. Exercises the tier-2 classifier; not a finished taxonomy.

angles.name: grasping a whole system
angles.definition: The click when scattered pieces resolve into one structure you can hold at once. The pleasure is the resolution — the moment the parts stop being a list and become a shape.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from mastering-a-technique (procedural — knowing how to do the steps) and from completing-the-collection (accumulation without structure). Here the payoff is that the whole becomes graspable, not that it becomes complete.
trigger_phrasings: it finally made sense as one thing

angles.name: chasing an anomaly
angles.definition: The pull of the thing that doesn't fit — the exception, the glitch, the detail that shouldn't be there. Attention snags on the discrepancy and won't let go.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from grasping-a-whole-system: there the pleasure is resolution, here it is the unresolved snag itself. Distinct from following-a-thread-to-its-end, which follows a through-line rather than a rupture.

angles.name: making the unspoken explicit
angles.definition: Naming a thing everyone feels but no one has articulated; giving structure to the tacit. The satisfaction is in the words finally existing.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from the-pleasure-of-the-right-frame (which makes a problem tractable) — here nothing becomes easier, it becomes SAYABLE. Distinct from refining-toward-precision, which sharpens language that already exists.
trigger_phrasings: could never put it in words until
there's no word for this but
that's exactly the thing nobody talks about

angles.name: inhabiting another mind
angles.definition: Temporarily thinking as someone else would — a character, an author, a historical figure. The interest is in the occupancy, not the observation.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from making-the-unspoken-explicit, which analyzes from outside; here you are inside the frame, reasoning from their premises. Distinct from seeing-through-the-official-story, which is suspicious of the other mind rather than resident in it.
trigger_phrasings: from where they were standing it makes sense
how did this look to them

angles.name: refining toward precision
angles.definition: The last 10% — tightening, cutting, getting the phrasing or the proof exactly right. The gap between nearly-right and right is where the whole interest lives.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from building-something-that-works (function, not polish) and from getting-the-texture-right (authenticity, not correctness). Here the target is exactness.

angles.name: following a thread to its end
angles.definition: The compulsion to chase an idea through every implication, wherever it leads — including somewhere inconvenient.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from chasing-an-anomaly: there the object is a snag, here it is a through-line that keeps going. Distinct from dismantling-to-understand, which goes down into a thing rather than onward from it.
trigger_phrasings: if that's true then this has to be too

angles.name: seeing through the official story
angles.definition: The draw of the hidden mechanism under the stated one — what is really going on beneath the surface account.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from dismantling-to-understand (which takes apart a thing that isn't hiding anything) and from chasing-an-anomaly (a detail that doesn't fit, rather than a story that is a front).

angles.name: building something that works
angles.definition: The satisfaction of a thing you made actually functioning — the test passing, the machine running, the thing doing what it was for.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from refining-toward-precision, which is polish on something already working; here the whole event is the transition from not-working to working.
trigger_phrasings: it actually does the thing now

angles.name: holding two opposed ideas
angles.definition: The tension of a genuine paradox — both true, and the interest is precisely in not collapsing it to one side.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from the-pleasure-of-the-right-frame, which dissolves the difficulty; here dissolving it would destroy the thing worth having. Distinct from finding-the-load-bearing-piece, which resolves toward a single crux.

angles.name: finding the load-bearing piece
angles.definition: Locating the one element everything else depends on — the crux, the keystone, the thing that if wrong makes the rest wrong.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from grasping-a-whole-system (the shape of everything) — here it is the single point of maximum leverage. Distinct from holding-two-opposed-ideas, which refuses a single resolution.

angles.name: watching a pattern repeat
angles.definition: Recognizing the same shape across unrelated domains — the isomorphism. The interest is in the recurrence itself.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from grasping-a-whole-system, which is structure WITHIN one thing; here the structure is the correspondence BETWEEN things that have no business matching.

angles.name: getting the texture right
angles.definition: Fidelity to how a thing actually feels or sounds — the specific, lived detail chosen over the generic stand-in.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from refining-toward-precision: that one chases correctness, this one chases authenticity. A sentence can be exactly correct and still have the wrong texture.
trigger_phrasings: that's not how anyone actually talks

angles.name: dismantling to understand
angles.definition: Taking a thing apart to see how it works, even at the cost of the thing. The knowledge is worth the breakage.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from seeing-through-the-official-story, which assumes something is concealed; here nothing is hidden — it is just closed, and you want it open. Distinct from following-a-thread-to-its-end, which moves outward rather than inward.

angles.name: the pleasure of the right frame
angles.definition: When a reframe suddenly makes a hard thing tractable — the problem dissolving under a better lens rather than yielding to force.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from grasping-a-whole-system (seeing the structure that is already there) — here you SUPPLY a structure that was not given. Distinct from holding-two-opposed-ideas, which values the difficulty that this one removes.
trigger_phrasings: if you think of it as
the trick is to see it
once you look at it that way it's easy

angles.name: completing the collection
angles.definition: The itch to close a set — the last piece, the full map, the gap filled. The set being finished is the point.
angles.felt_distinction_from_neighbors: Distinct from grasping-a-whole-system: that wants structure, this wants completeness. A collection can be complete and shapeless and still scratch this itch.
